newsitem.title: USA: First Merchants named in shareholder suit.
newsitem.headline: First Merchants named in shareholder suit.

text.p: A shareholder lawsuit seeking class action status has been filed against First Merchants Acceptance Corp, the law firm of Kaplan, Kilsheimer & Fox LLP, which is representing plaintiffs, said Tuesday.
The law firm said it filed the complaint in the federal court for the Northern District of Illinois on behalf of buyers of First Merchants common stock between April 18, 1996 and April 16, 1996.

The complaint accuses the auto finance company and certain officers and directors of the company of violating federal securities laws for allegedly misrepresenting and concealing material facts concerning the company's business, financial statements and earnings growth.
On April 16, the Deerfield, Ill.,-based company said it would restate its 1996 results after finding "irregulatories involving unauthorized entries" in its records.
First Merchants was not immediately available to comment.
